metadata.description: Embedded systems, firmware, and IoT plugins for Claude Code, from bare metal to RTOS.

plugins.name: arm-cortex-m
plugins.description: ARM Cortex-M programming, CMSIS, HAL, startup code

plugins.name: bare-metal
plugins.description: Bare metal programming, register manipulation, linker scripts

plugins.name: bootloader-design
plugins.description: Bootloader architecture, firmware update mechanisms, secure boot

plugins.name: communication-buses
plugins.description: Bus drivers look simple until you ship one.

plugins.name: debug-trace
plugins.description: JTAG, SWD, printf debugging, trace analysis, fault handlers

plugins.name: embedded-linux
plugins.description: Yocto, Buildroot, device trees, kernel modules

plugins.name: embedded-testing
plugins.description: Unit testing on target, HIL testing, mocking hardware

plugins.name: firmware-update
plugins.description: OTA updates, firmware versioning, rollback mechanisms

plugins.name: fpga-integration
plugins.description: FPGA/MCU integration, HDL basics, soft cores, IP blocks

plugins.name: iot-protocols
plugins.description: Connectivity is rarely "just add WiFi." The choice between MQTT and CoAP depends on whether you need reliable delivery or low overhead.

plugins.name: memory-management
plugins.description: Static allocation, memory pools, stack/heap analysis, MPU

plugins.name: power-management
plugins.description: Sleep modes, power budgeting, energy harvesting, battery

plugins.name: rtos-patterns
plugins.description: Real-time operating systems are not just "scheduler plus mutex." They are an opinionated set of trade-offs between latency, determinism, footprint, and developer ergonomics.

plugins.name: safety-critical
plugins.description: IEC 61508, DO-178C, MISRA C, static analysis, certification

plugins.name: sensor-integration
plugins.description: Sensor drivers, calibration, filtering, fusion algorithms
